title: BCA/11/2021 of SHIVANI SHARMA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Bail Cancellation Application No. 11 of 2021
Smt. Shivani Sharma ...Applicant
Versus

State of Uttarakhand and others ...Respondents
Present:-
Mr. Jasmeet Sahota, Advocate holding brief of
Mr. Harshpal Sekhon, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. M.A. Khan, AGA for the State.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Respondent no. 2 Ajay Kumar Sharma and
respondent no. 3 Smt. Bhawna Sharma were granted bail
in FIR/Case Crime No. 119 of 2019, under Sections 420,
406 IPC and Section 4/5 of the Prize Chits & Money
Circulation Schemes (Banning) Act, 1978, P.S. Dalanwala,
District Dehradun, on 09.12.2020 in BA 1 No. 2543 of
2019.
2. The bail order was subject to the condition that
the accused shall refund the money within two months
from the date of their release. On 09.12.2020, the Court
had further clarified that in case of non-compliance of the
bail order, the State as well as the aggrieved person will
have a right to move the bail cancellation application
before this Court.

2
3. Now the applicant has moved the bail
cancellation application on the ground that the respondent
nos. 2 and 3 have not refunded money subject to which
they were granted bail.
4. The respondent nos. 2 and 3 were informed.
They were represented before the Court. On 06.06.2023,
on behalf of the respondent nos. 2 and 3, time was sought.
But, today, none is present for the respondent nos. 2 & 3.
5. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well
as the learned State Counsel and perused the record.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit
that the private respondents were granted similar bail in
other similarly situated cases and due to non-compliance
of the conditions, their bail has been cancelled by this
Court. He would refer to the order dated 12.01.2023
passed in Bail Cancellation Application No. 9 of 2021 and
Bail Cancellation Application No. 10 of 2021, which reveals
that under similar circumstances, the bail was granted to
the private respondents with the same conditions. After
referring to the deliberations that were made by the
respondent nos. 2 and 3 in the earlier bail cancellation
applications, the Court had cancelled their bail.

3
7. Learned State Counsel would submit that since
the private respondents have not complied with the
conditions of the bail, the bail deserves to be cancelled. In
Bail Cancellation Application No. 9 of 2021 and Bail
Cancellation Application No. 10 of 2021, this Court on
12.01.2024, inter alia, observed as follows:-
"15. In the case of Bhupinder Singh Vs. Unitech
Limited, (2020) 18 SCC 406, a conditional bail
order was passed subject to deposition of some
money, which was not deposited. The Hon'ble
Supreme Court, under such facts, observed that
the bail granted may not be enlarged because the
accused in that case did not comply with the
conditions on which he was granted bail. In Para
12, the Hon'ble Supreme Court observed as
hereunder:-
"12. By the order of this Court dated 30-10-
2017, Sanjay Chandra v. State (NCT of Delhi),
2017 SCC OnLine SC 1260, the petitioners
were admitted to bail, subject to the deposit of
an amount of Rs. 750 crores. The order in
that regard was passed by a three-Judge
Bench of this Court. At this stage, the
admitted facts before the Court indicate that
the order for the deposit of Rs. 750 crores has
not been complied with. The prayer for
enlargement on bail is misconceived
because the petitioners have been
admitted to bail, subject to the condition
of deposit which is not fulfilled. The two
Directors have been arrested following the
orders passed by the ACM. They failed to
obtain any order from the Delhi High Court."
(emphasis supplied)

4
16. In the instant case, the accused did not pay
even a single paisa either to the informant or to
any other aggrieved persons. An excuse was taken
on 05.01.2023 that the applicants are not
receiving the money. But, when the entire account
details were given to the accused persons, now, on
behalf of the accused, time is being sought. The
bail order, in the instant case, is not being taken
by this Court as money recovery suit. The bail
order was subject to a condition that the accused
would refund the money within two months. It is
more than 2 years, the money has not been
refunded. Apparently, the accused has violated the
condition subject to which they were granted bail.
Therefore, this Court has no other option but to
cancel the bail granted to the accused persons.
17. The bail cancellation applications are allowed.
18. The bail granted to accused- Ajay Kumar
Sharma and Smt. Bhawna Sharma in FIR No.127
of 2019 in BA1 No.2793 of 2019, is hereby
cancelled. Let them surrender to custody within
three days from today. If they fail to do so, the
concerned court is directed to issue coercive
processes so that they may be arrested and
remanded to judicial custody."
8. In the instant case, the bail order was subject to
the condition that the respondent nos. 2 and 3 would
refund the money within two months. It is more than three
years since then, but the money has not been given.
Therefore, it is abundantly clear that the respondent nos. 2
and 3 have violated the conditions, subject to which they
were granted bail. Therefore, this Court has no other

5
option except to cancel the bail granted to the respondent
nos. 2 and 3. Accordingly, the bail cancellation application
deserves to be allowed.
9. The bail cancellation application is allowed. The
bail granted to the respondent no. 2 Ajay Kumar Sharma
and the respondent no. 3 Smt. Bhawna Sharma in
FIR/Case Crime No. 119 of 2019, under Sections 420, 406
IPC and Section 4/5 of the Prize Chits & Money
Circulation Schemes (Banning) Act, 1978, P.S. Dalanwala,
District Dehradun is hereby cancelled. Let them surrender
to custody within three days from today. If they fail to do
so, the concerned court is directed to issue coercive
processes so that they may be arrested and remanded to
judicial custody.
10. Let a copy of this order be sent forthwith to the
court concerned.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 19.02.2024
Avneet/
